title: HR Absenteeism & Workforce Analytics Automation System
summary: Automated HR absenteeism reporting system transforming monthly Excel files into structured workforce analytics and interactive reporting matrices.
impact: Automated monthly absence data ingestion from Excel into SharePoint through Power Automate.
Built historical employee tracking to manage active, inactive, new, and transferred employees accurately.
Created dynamic HR reporting matrices for department, employee, organization, and absence type analysis.
Reduced manual calculations and improved reporting accuracy through centralized workforce data.
